samples.xml_description:
<module id="freq_div">
    <description>Design a frequency divider that divides the input clock frequency of 100MHz into 50MHz, 10MHz, and 1MHz signals.</description>
    <ports>
        <input id="CLK_in">Input clock signal.</input>
        <input id="RST">Reset signal.</input>
        <output id="CLK_50">Output clock signal with a frequency of CLK_in divided by 2.</output>
        <output id="CLK_10">Output clock signal with a frequency of CLK_in divided by 10.</output>
        <output id="CLK_1">Output clock signal with a frequency of CLK_in divided by 100.</output>
    </ports>
    <parameter_description>
        <parameter id="div_50">Parameter for dividing the clock frequency by 2.</parameter>
        <parameter id="div_10">Parameter for dividing the clock frequency by 10.</parameter>
        <parameter id="div_1">Parameter for dividing the clock frequency by 100.</parameter>
    </parameter_description>
    <logic_description>
        <sequential_logic id="div_50">
            <description>Divide the input clock signal by 2.</description>
            <trigger>Positive edge of CLK_in or RST.</trigger>
            <action>
                <if>
                    <condition>RST is active.</condition>
                    <then>Set CLK_50 to 0.</then>
                </if>
                <else>
                    <then>Invert CLK_50.</then>
                </else>
            </action>
        </sequential_logic>
        <sequential_logic id="div_10">
            <description>Divide the input clock signal by 10.</description>
            <trigger>Positive edge of CLK_in or RST.</trigger>
            <action>
                <if>
                    <condition>RST is active.</condition>
                    <then>
                        <set>Set CLK_10 to 0.</set>
                        <set>Reset counter cnt_10 to 0.</set>
                    </then>
                </if>
                <elseif>
                    <condition>Counter cnt_10 reaches a value of 9.</condition>
                    <then>
                        <set>Invert CLK_10.</set>
                        <set>Reset counter cnt_10 to 0.</set>
                    </then>
                </elseif>
                <else>
                    <then>Increment counter cnt_10 by 1.</then>
                </else>
            </action>
        </sequential_logic>
        <sequential_logic id="div_1">
            <description>Divide the input clock signal by 100.</description>
            <trigger>Positive edge of CLK_in or RST.</trigger>
            <action>
                <if>
                    <condition>RST is active.</condition>
                    <then>
                        <set>Set CLK_1 to 0.</set>
                        <set>Reset counter cnt_100 to 0.</set>
                    </then>
                </if>
                <elseif>
                    <condition>Counter cnt_100 reaches a value of 99.</condition>
                    <then>
                        <set>Invert CLK_1.</set>
                        <set>Reset counter cnt_100 to 0.</set>
                    </then>
                </elseif>
                <else>
                    <then>Increment counter cnt_100 by 1.</then>
                </else>
            </action>
        </sequential_logic>
    </logic_description>
    <implementation>Implement frequency division logic for CLK_50, CLK_10, and CLK_1.</implementation>
</module>
